queries_run: CVS Health antitrust OR monopoly investigation 2026 FTC DOJ PBM
CVS Health regulation OR regulatory scrutiny Healthcare Plans 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 載明：CMS 每年稽核所有 Medicare Advantage 合約（RADV），DOJ 民事部門就風險調整診斷碼寄出 CID；風險調整機制變動可能實質影響 Medicare 給付。
findings.excerpt: The Company also has received Civil Investigative Demands (“CIDs”) from, and provided documents and information to, the Civil Division of the DOJ in connection with investigations of the Company’s identification and/or submission of diagnosis codes related to risk adjustment payments

findings.claim: 10-K 載明：若公司在相關市場有實際或潛在市場力，其商業安排可能受 FTC／州／聯邦監管機關加強審查與挑戰。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1 Antitrust and Unfair Competition
findings.excerpt: To the extent that the Company appears to have actual or potential market power in a relevant market or CVS pharmacy, CVS specialty or MinuteClinic plays a unique or expanded role in a Health Care Benefits or Health Services segment product offering, the Company’s business arrangements and uses of confidential information may be subject to heightened scrutiny

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要：佛州檢察長就 Caremark 是否導流至自家藥局、對關係藥局給付較優，對 CVS 發出民事調查令（CID）；尚未指控違法，CVS 表示配合但不同意其損害理論。
findings.source: Duane Morris, Florida Attorney General Examines Alleged Anticompetitive Pharmacy Practices by PBM, Parent Company

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋摘要另提及 2026-01 眾議院司法委員會中期報告指控 Caremark 可能違反反托拉斯法、及 Caremark 與 FTC 胰島素案 2026-07-14 和解，均為二手摘要，未核原文。未見 FTC／DOJ 針對 CVS 的拆分或壟斷訴訟。第三次搜尋未下。

clues.claim: 眾議院司法委員會 2026-01 中期報告稱 CVS 可能以 Caremark 針對獨立及數位競爭藥局而違反反托拉斯法
